name: Eren Yeager
desc: A boy who sought freedom, driven by an unyielding desire to eradicate his enemies. His journey reshapes the entire world.

name: Mikasa Ackerman
desc: Bound by devotion and unparalleled combat skill. She protects what remains of her family with lethal precision.

name: Armin Arlert
desc: A brilliant tactician whose mind is sharper than any blade. He inherited the Colossal Titan to save humanity.

name: Levi Ackerman
desc: Humanity's strongest soldier. Cold, calculating, and capable of taking down the most fearsome Titans single-handedly.
